problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Unconstrained monotone root finding: find an approximate zero of a continuous operator F:E→E satisfying ⟨F(x)−F(y),x−y⟩≥0. E is an arbitrary real inner-product space; completeness and finite dimensionality are not required. No objective or saddle function is specified.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Exact operator-value oracle: every query x returns F(x), for every call index and seed. There is no oracle error or sample dependence. Each evaluation counts as one oracle call under a fixed budget.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedLipschitzMonotone.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: execute, Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x,y and every M bounding ‖F‖ throughout their line segment, ‖F(x)−F(y)‖≤(L0+L1M)‖x−y‖. L0>0 and L1≥0 are public parameters.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedLipschitzMonotone.lean: Public.L0, Public.L1, spec.valid, segment-bound clause of spec.admissible.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The initial point x0 is public. Hidden parameters G≥0 and R≥0 satisfy ‖F(x0)‖≤G and guarantee a zero xstar with ‖x0−xstar‖≤R. The tolerance ε>0 is also hidden: the algorithm constructor receives only E, L0, L1, and x0, while the execution budget may depend on G, R, and ε.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/GeneralizedLipschitzMonotone.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.valid, final clauses of spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.makeAlgorithm and budget.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The residual bound must hold almost surely under the joint algorithm-seed and oracle-seed law. The oracle-call budget holds for every seed.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: The returned point must satisfy the unsquared operator residual bound ‖F(output)‖≤ε. No averaging, best-iterate selection, or distance-to-solution requirement is imposed.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Monotone root finding is established, but this setup replaces global Lipschitz continuity with an operator-magnitude-dependent segment condition and requires a constructor independent of the hidden radius, initial residual bound, and tolerance.
